integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite certificate with independent direct small-case enumeration; no claim of external certification or novel general decision algorithm.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for lengths one less than powers of two; no classification of all arbitrary prefixes. The pre-existing Walnut automaton recognizes every prefix/pair relation, so implicit computability is already known. Independent audit has not been performed.
